name: c0de/security
description: The security library keeps secrets in your vault and needs INCLUDE c0de/security. Every player has a vault while they are online. It vanishes when they leave. A program uses the vault of the player who started it, and only if that player owns the sheet. Otherwise its functions raise VAULT_UNAVAILABLE. Programs read secrets with SECRET lines. A persistent vault keeps secrets in a KeePass file that only your game can open with your password.
